title.sl: Preveč, dovolj, tako kot: too, enough, as … as
title.de: Zu, genug, so wie: too, enough, as … as
title.it: Troppo, abbastanza, come: too, enough, as … as

rule.sl:
**too** (preveč) pove, da je več, kot hočeš: **It's too cold.** (Prehladno je.) **very** (zelo) je samo veliko: **It's very cold, but I like it.**

**enough** (dovolj) stoji za pridevnikom, a pred samostalnikom: **warm enough**, **enough water**. Slovenščina ima pri pridevniku obratni red: *dovolj toplo*.

Naprej gre s **to**: **too cold to swim** (prehladno za plavanje), **old enough to drive**. S **for** gre oseba ali -ing: **too big for me**, **too cold for swimming**.

**too much** + kar se ne šteje: **too much salt**. **too many** + množina: **too many sheep**.

Od malo do zelo: **a bit cold**, **quite cold**, **very cold**, **really cold**. **quite** je v Britaniji *kar*, v Ameriki pogosto *zelo*. Pred samostalnikom: **quite a long walk**. V govoru tudi **pretty cold**, na severu **right cold**, **dead good**.

**as … as** pove, da je enako: **Jack is as tall as Sam.** (Jack je tako visok kot Sam.) **not as … as** pove manj: **The mill isn't as old as the inn.** Oba sta **as**, ne *than*. V govoru **as tall as me**, v pisavi tudi **as tall as I am**.
rule.de:
**too** (zu) sagt, dass es mehr ist, als du willst: **It's too cold.** (Es ist zu kalt.) **very** (sehr) ist nur viel: **It's very cold, but I like it.**

**enough** (genug) steht wie im Deutschen nach dem Adjektiv und vor dem Nomen: **warm enough**, **enough water**.

Weiter geht es mit **to**: **too cold to swim** (zu kalt zum Schwimmen), **old enough to drive**. Mit **for** kommt eine Person oder -ing: **too big for me**, **too cold for swimming**.

**too much** + was man nicht zählt: **too much salt**. **too many** + Plural: **too many sheep**.

Von wenig bis sehr: **a bit cold**, **quite cold**, **very cold**, **really cold**. **quite** heißt britisch *ziemlich*, amerikanisch oft *sehr*. Vor einem Nomen: **quite a long walk**. Gesprochen auch **pretty cold**, im Norden **right cold**, **dead good**.

**as … as** sagt, dass es gleich ist, wo Deutsch *so … wie* sagt: **Jack is as tall as Sam.** (Jack ist so groß wie Sam.) **not as … as** sagt weniger: **The mill isn't as old as the inn.** Beide Male **as**, nicht *than*. Gesprochen **as tall as me**, geschrieben auch **as tall as I am**.
rule.it:
**too** (troppo) dice che è più di quanto vuoi: **It's too cold.** (Fa troppo freddo.) **very** (molto) è solo tanto: **It's very cold, but I like it.**

**enough** (abbastanza) sta dopo l'aggettivo e prima del nome: **warm enough**, **enough water**. L'italiano ha l'ordine opposto con l'aggettivo: *abbastanza caldo*.

Si continua con **to**: **too cold to swim** (troppo freddo per nuotare), **old enough to drive**. Con **for** viene una persona o -ing: **too big for me**, **too cold for swimming**.

**too much** + ciò che non si conta: **too much salt**. **too many** + plurale: **too many sheep**.

Da poco a molto: **a bit cold**, **quite cold**, **very cold**, **really cold**. **quite** in Gran Bretagna è *abbastanza*, in America spesso *molto*. Davanti a un nome: **quite a long walk**. A voce anche **pretty cold**, al nord **right cold**, **dead good**.

**as … as** dice che è uguale, dove l'italiano dice *come*: **Jack is as tall as Sam.** (Jack è alto come Sam.) **not as … as** dice meno: **The mill isn't as old as the inn.** Tutte e due le volte **as**, non *than*. A voce **as tall as me**, per iscritto anche **as tall as I am**.
rule.en:
**too** says it is more than you want: **It's too cold.** **very** only says a lot: **It's very cold, but I like it.**

**enough** stands after an adjective and before a noun: **warm enough**, **enough water**.

Go on with **to**: **too cold to swim**, **old enough to drive**. **for** takes a person or -ing: **too big for me**, **too cold for swimming**.

**too much** + what you can't count: **too much salt**. **too many** + a plural: **too many sheep**.

From a little to a lot: **a bit cold**, **quite cold**, **very cold**, **really cold**. In Britain **quite** is fairly; in America it is often very. Before a noun: **quite a long walk**. In talk also **pretty cold**, in the North **right cold**, **dead good**.

**as … as** says they are the same: **Jack is as tall as Sam.** **not as … as** says less: **The mill isn't as old as the inn.** **as** both times, not *than*. In talk **as tall as me**, in writing also **as tall as I am**.

examples.en: It's too cold. I'm going home.
examples.de: Es ist zu kalt. Ich gehe heim.
examples.it: Fa troppo freddo. Vado a casa.

examples.en: Alfie is too young to drive.
examples.de: Alfie ist zu jung zum Autofahren.
examples.it: Alfie è troppo giovane per guidare.

examples.en: There are too many sheep on the road.
examples.de: Auf der Straße sind zu viele Schafe.
examples.it: Ci sono troppe pecore sulla strada.

examples.en: The mill isn't as old as the inn.
examples.sl: Mlin ni tako star kot gostilna.
examples.de: Die Mühle ist nicht so alt wie das Gasthaus.
examples.it: Il mulino non è vecchio come la locanda.
